entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Esteban Gómez Carreño was a Chilean naval officer. He first joined the navy aged 15 on board the Huáscar, later serving as squadron commander-in-chief. He became director of the Naval School and Minister of War and the Navy under the September Junta.

entities.summary: Luis Esteban Gómez Carreño was a Chilean naval officer. He first joined the navy aged 15 on board the Huáscar, later serving as squadron commander-in-chief. He became director of the Naval School and Minister of War and the Navy under the September Junta.
